title: Cemeteries?
content: Does anyone else have cemeteries around the mall world? The last time I dreamed about it there were cemeteries on these floating islands. There were huge mausoleums and wide stairs and platforms led to the entrance of what was the “mall” and there was a long line to get in, maybe you were waiting in line with me. I tried using chatgpt to render an image but its missing some elements. For some reason the headstone have Chinese characters on them.
